No 'Unmatched Route' text, no 'missing default export' text, no page/JS errors. (2) Direct URL /live?code=QG8AGQ also loads cleanly. (3) Invalid codes: 'ABC' and 'ZZZZZZ' both show inline testID=scan-error 'Meet not found' and the app stays on the join screen (url does not change to /live). critical_code_review_comments: AdMobBanner.tsx correctly guards with Constants.executionEnvironment === ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient AND uses require() (not top-level import) so react-native-google-mobile-ads is only touched in a real dev/prod native build — this addresses the exact Expo Go crash root cause described in the report.
AdMobBanner.web.tsx returns null and Metro's platform-specific resolver picks it for web — verified by admob-banner testID count = 0 on /live and /control.
live.tsx imports the wrapper via '@/src/components/AdMobBanner' and renders <AdMobBanner /> after </ScrollView>; both web (stub) and Expo Go (null via runtime guard) render cleanly.
server.py public_meet() strips passcode on GET /api/meets/{code} and GET /api/meets/id/{id}/read — confirmed by 26/26 backend tests including no-passcode-leak assertions.
scan.tsx resolveCode correctly surfaces 'Meet not found' from getMeet() and does NOT navigate on error — verified with ABC and ZZZZZZ inputs.

rca_of_issue: N/A — bug already fixed. Original RCA (from problem statement): app/live.tsx imported src/components/AdMobBanner which had a top-level `import from 'react-native-google-mobile-ads'`; in Expo Go the native module doesn't exist, so evaluating the module crashed the /live screen (uncaught error) and expo-router then surfaced 'Unmatched Route'. FIX (verified): AdMobBanner.tsx now (a) reads Constants.executionEnvironment and returns null when isExpoGo, (b) uses require() inside useEffect + the render function so the SDK is lazy-loaded only on non-Expo-Go native, and (c) AdMobBanner.web.tsx provides a platform-specific stub so Metro never bundles the native SDK for web. Verified: /live loads cleanly on web with no unmatched route, no red screen, no page errors; admob-banner testID count = 0.
